upcoming.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
upcoming.note: Nintendo US完整商品页确认2026年11月5日、Nintendo Switch 2平台及从头为该主机构建的版本身份。
Xbox Wire一手周报确认11月6日档期；Xbox US商品页另确认Xbox One、Xbox Series X|S、PC与Play Anywhere能力。
Activision在PlayStation Blog一手稿件明确写明Season 1于2026年11月6日上线，并列出首发地图、模式与DMZ内容；平台仅按该页可确认的PS5范围记录。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 Arrives November 11

entries.headline: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game Releases Its Major Avatar State Update
entries.summary: The Avatar State Patch is now live on Xbox Series X|S, overhauling menus and match displays, reworking Avatar Aang and Nightmare Korra, and adding Ranked Mode 2.0, quality-of-life improvements, and roster-wide balance changes.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire provided a first-party developer article. The date follows the article and its “available today” wording; no other platforms are inferred.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire said the patch was available on October 30, 2026; no exact launch time was provided.

entries.headline: Queen’s Domain Launches on Xbox Series X|S
entries.summary: The retro-fantasy action RPG is now available on Xbox Series X|S, stranding players alone on the monster-infested island of Neasied alongside a set of official beginner tips.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire’s first-party developer article explicitly confirms availability, platform, and gameplay framing.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire announced availability on October 30, 2026; no exact time was provided.

entries.headline: Terrible Lizards Launches on Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass
entries.summary: The first-person dinosaur horror parkour game is now available on Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass. Its developer also outlined a movement system built around escaping runaway dinosaur animatronics in an abandoned roadside attraction.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire’s first-party developer article explicitly confirms release status, Xbox platform, and Game Pass availability.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire said the game was available on October 30, 2026; no exact time was provided.

entries.headline: THE WORLD OF BIOHAZARD 30th Anniversary Exhibition Opens in Shibuya
entries.summary: The exhibition runs from October 30 through December 24 at BEAM Gallery in Shibuya, Tokyo. Two Japanese press previews describe a retrospective built around 30 years of series history, development materials, and life-size displays.
entries.verification: Opened reports from 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer independently corroborate the dates, venue, and core exhibition focus.
entries.timeNote: The exhibition runs from October 30 to December 24, 2026.

entries.headline: Kirby Air Riders Halts Its Halloween Event After a Screen-Freeze Issue
entries.summary: Nintendo canceled the ongoing “Trick or Treat!” event after confirming an issue that could temporarily freeze the screen during play. Kirby Air Riders is available on Nintendo Switch 2.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON explicitly relays Nintendo’s October 30 notice and preserves the stated issue and reason for cancellation.
entries.timeNote: Nintendo issued the notice on October 30, 2026.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27 Opens a Free Launch Preview Through November 4
entries.summary: The PC Launch Preview is free through November 4 on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Microsoft Store; the Microsoft Store build is available to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers. Saves carry into the full game.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON explicitly relays SEGA’s announcement, including the free window, storefront coverage, and save transfer.
entries.timeNote: The preview began October 30, 2026 and remains free through November 4.

entries.headline: Gothic 1 Remake Releases Feature Update #1
entries.summary: THQ Nordic’s first free feature update adds the series’ traditional Marvin Mode cheat system and Photo Mode. The game is currently sold for PC via Steam and GOG.com and for Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON explicitly relays THQ Nordic’s update announcement and lists the main additions and current platforms.

entries.headline: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 Arrives November 11
entries.summary: Version 4.7, “Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars,” advances the final Phantasmoon performance, introduces Aeon Aha as a limited five-star character, and adds the Affinitive Eidolon growth system.
entries.verification: Gematsu explicitly relays miHoYo’s announcement. Chinese title and version terminology were normalized only through an official Simplified Chinese channel and add no event facts.
entries.timeNote: Version 4.7 launches on November 11, 2026; no exact time was provided.

entries.headline: WORLD OF HORROR Releases the Free AS BELOW SO ABOVE Update on PC
entries.summary: Ysbryd Games and Panstasz have released the major free update on PC, saying it adds about 20 percent more content. PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions are planned for 2027.
entries.verification: Gematsu explicitly relays the publisher and developer announcement, including current PC availability, the 20 percent figure, and the console-year window.
entries.timeNote: The PC update became available on October 30, 2026; PS4 and Switch are confirmed only for 2027.

entries.headline: John Romero Says His Canceled Project Has a New Publisher and a 15–16 Person Team
entries.summary: Romero told VGC at Gamescom Asia that the previously defunded project has found a new publisher, but the team shrank from more than 100 people to roughly 15–16 and the concept was completely redesigned. The publisher and game remain unannounced.
entries.verification: Game Developer reports VGC’s interview with John Romero. The summary preserves the fact that the publisher and project details remain undisclosed.
entries.timeNote: The report was published October 30, 2026; the packet does not provide the interview’s exact date.

entries.headline: viviON GAMES Plans to Expand Its Cloud-Gaming Catalog
entries.summary: viviON representative Toshiki Horita told AUTOMATON that the platform wants to reach a broader audience and add more supported titles. It runs server-side PC games in a mobile browser and sells games individually rather than through a subscription.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON interview notes that it was conducted at OSAKA INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2026 and that the article was provided by the event organizer.
entries.timeNote: The interview was conducted October 3, 2026 and published October 30.

entries.headline: Probably Stolen Sells 350,000 Copies in 24 Hours and Peaks at 112,000 Concurrent Players
entries.summary: tinyBuild says the cyberpunk pawn-shop simulator reached 350,000 sales and 112,000 peak concurrent players in its first 24 hours. Its predecessor demo, Deepspace Emporium, peaked at 28 players before the publisher and developer reworked its visuals and design focus.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON attributes the sales, concurrency, and predecessor figures to tinyBuild’s official account or CEO Alex Nichiporchik. They are not presented as independently audited platform data.
entries.timeNote: The game launched October 28, 2026; the figures cover its first 24 hours.

entries.headline: Bungie Clarifies That Destiny’s Future Does Not Depend on Marathon
entries.summary: Product head Josh Deane said players should not buy Marathon as a donation to the studio and that Bungie’s Destiny plan is not contingent on Marathon’s performance, urging people to play only what inspires them.
entries.verification: IGN quotes Josh Deane’s public responses. This summary does not infer Bungie’s finances or long-term outcomes for either game.
entries.timeNote: IGN published the report on October 30, 2026; the packet does not provide the exact time of the public responses.
